item.title: Pharmacy Benefit Management Consulting Services
item.description:
NYC Health + Hospitals | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-16 In plain English (machine-written): NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals through a Request for Proposals from consultants to advise its MetroPlusHealth insurance arm on pharmacy and medical drug benefit programs, with responses due Nov. 16, 2026.

MetroPlusHealth is seeking consultant services specializing in Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), to provide strategic, operational, financial, clinical, and regulatory expertise related to both pharmacy benefit and medical benefit drug management programs.The selected vendor will support MetroPlusHealths evaluation, optimization, oversight, and long-term strategic planning of pharmacy and provider-administered drug benefits across all lines of business.The selected vendor will serve as a strategic advisor to MetroPlusHealth providing independent expertise and analysis to support informed decision-making, effective vendor oversight, and the continued optimization of pharmacy and medical drug benefit programs.

item.title: Rubrik Enterprise
item.description:
NYC Health + Hospitals | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-10-23 In plain English (machine-written): NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking competitive sealed bids, due Oct. 23, 2026, from qualified resellers to provide Rubrik's enterprise backup software for MetroPlus, covering virtual servers, Isilon file shares, ransomware malware scanning and ongoing support and patching.

MetroPlus is seeking qualified resellers capable of providing Rubrik an enterprise-wide backup solution that protects our virtual servers and Isilon file shares. There is also a ransomware detection piece that is utilized to inspect our backups for known malware. Support is required to keep our backup system and its components up to date and patched at the latest levels.

item.description:
NYC Health + Hospitals | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-06 In plain English (machine-written): NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals from vendors to provide provider data management services for MetroPlusHealth, covering areas such as credentialing, contracting, claims and provider directories, with responses due Nov. 6, 2026.

MetroPlusHealth is seeking a qualified vendor to provide a comprehensive Provider Data Management and Maintenance solution that supports the end-to-end lifecycle management of provider data across multiple lines of business and operational functions, including provider network management, credentialing, contracting, claims administration, provider directories, regulatory reporting, and compliance activities.

item.title: Medical Malpractice Defense Services
item.description:
NYC Health + Hospitals | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-02 In plain English (machine-written): NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals from law firms to defend it and its medical staff in high-exposure medical malpractice claims, with responses due Nov. 2, 2026.

NYC Health + Hospitals seeks to obtain proposals from law firms that specialize in the defense of medical malpractice claims. The successfully awarded firms will defend NYC Health + Hospitals and its medical staff in high exposure medical malpractice claims.  Defense counsel may also be assigned to represent physicians insured by NYC Health + Hospitals' captive insurance company, the HHC Insurance Company (HHCIC) and its medical staff in regulatory matters.  Defense counsel is also expected to provide legal assistance concerning NYC Health + Hospitals Risk Management and Quality Assurance programs, be available to consult on regulatory matters, assist hospital risk managers and conduct in-service lectures.

item.title: Systemwide Commissioning Services
item.description:
NYC Health + Hospitals | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-10-16 In plain English (machine-written): NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals from vendors for systemwide commissioning services, which verify that building systems at its facilities are installed and working as intended, with responses due Oct. 16, 2026.

NYC Health & Hospitals requests proposals for facility commissioning services related to new construction, facility renovations, re-commissioning of existing systems, or facility system assessments throughout its portfolio of buildings. The types of facilities to be commissioned may include office/administration, hospitals, health clinics, laboratories, or combinations thereof.

Commissioning is a systematic quality-assurance process used to verify and document that building systems and components are designed, installed, tested, started, operated, and maintained in accordance with NYC Health & Hospitals Project Requirements, Basis of Design, contract documents, and applicable performance criteria. The commissioning process shall confirm, prior to Substantial Completion and Owner acceptance, that the systems are complete and functioning as intended and that NYC Health & Hospitals facility staff have received adequate operating documentation and training…
